subject: Observability add-on pricing: retention + tracing scenarios and trade-offs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Barlow <tom.barlow@opsly.io>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-on pricing: retention + tracing scenarios and trade-offs

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As requested, I put together three pragmatic pricing scenarios for Opsly’s observability needs (retention, tracing ingestion, and advanced dashboarding). The attached Opsly_Retention_Proposal.xlsx has raw numbers; below is a summarized view so we can align quickly.

Summary (monthly examples, list price before commit discounts):
- Baseline (Pilot): 30-day hot retention, sampling-based tracing; dashboards: up to 5 seats. Est. incremental cost: $1,200/month (ingestion + hot storage + 5 seats).
- Production-Balanced: 90-day hot + 365-day cold (tiered archive), full tracing ingestion w/ 10k spans/day, dashboards: 20 seats. Est. incremental cost: $6,500/month.
- Long-Tail/Enterprise: 365-day hot+cold combined, full tracing w/ low sampling and trace storage, advanced dashboards & historical queries. Est. incremental cost: $21,000/month.

Commit discounts and options:
- 12-month commit: 18% off list for observability add-ons (applies to ingestion + storage line items).
- 24-month commit: 28% off list.
- Short pilot: 3-month pilot with $10k credits towards usage if you convert to a paid commit within 60 days.

A few trade-offs to consider: higher hot-retention reduces query latency for historical dashboards but increases monthly storage; tracing ingestion is the main variable (samples per second/spans/day); dashboards have a fixed per-seat component plus a small query egress band.

Next steps: can we set a 30-min call to pick a scenario and confirm expected span/day and dashboard seats? If you’re comfortable, we can also provide a redline-friendly SOW draft and run the pricing through legal for a concession path.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Opsly_Retention_Proposal.xlsx

From: Tom Barlow <tom.barlow@opsly.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: sales@opsly.io
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing: retention + tracing scenarios and trade-offs

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. A couple of follow-ups before we lock on a scenario:

1) Can you break the ingestion cost into per-GB and per-ingest-request (or per-span) components? Our ops team prefers per-ingest numbers so we can model spikes.
2) We need a fair-use / burst policy for tracing ingestion—what happens if we blow past the agreed average for 72 hrs?
3) For the archive (365-day cold), is retrieval charged per-query or is it part of the dashboard seat/query bundle?

Also, legal will want any retention guarantees and a sample clause describing data egress/export and deletion timelines. I can loop in our procurement person once we have per-unit economics.

Tom
Director, Platform Engineering
Opsly
Attachment: Opsly_Governance_SA.pdf

Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-on pricing: retention + tracing scenarios and trade-offs

Tom —

Appreciate the questions. Quick answers and an explicit per-unit breakout below (attached is a one-page pricing_breakdown_20280327.pdf too).

Per-unit pricing (list):
- Tracing ingestion: $0.15 per 1k spans ingested (approx $150 per 1M spans); burst charge: ingestion up to 3x agreed sustained rate is absorbed for up to 48 hours. Sustained breach beyond that will be billed at 1.5x ingestion rate until rate normalizes or we enact temporary throttling (we’ll always notify).
- Metric/ingest payload: $0.025 per GB ingested
- Hot storage (indexed): $0.40 per GB-month for first 90 days, then $0.12 per GB-month in cold/archive tier
- Dashboard seats: $90 per seat/month for advanced dashboards; includes 2M query credits/month (additional queries at $0.003 per query).

Retrieval and archive behavior:
- Archive queries that require re-hydration (cold -> hot) incur a $0.10 per GB rehydrate fee; repeated rehydrates on the same dataset are eligible for a waiver if covered by a committed SLO and agreed runbook.

Commit options (reiterating):
- 12m 200k USD commit: 18% off list for observability lines + 5k free query credits
- 24m 400k USD commit: 28% off list + 20k free query credits

Fair-use / burst policy: we’ll include a clause in the SOW that describes temporary absorption of burst (up to 3x sustained for <=48h) and an escalation path for prolonged events; permanent sustained overages are billing triggers. We can add a protective cap if Opsly prefers to avoid surprise overages.

If you can confirm expected monthly spans and monthly GB ingest (rough), I’ll run a committed pricing simulation and update the SOW redline. Would you prefer I send the SOW to your procurement contact or directly to legal?

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing_breakdown_20280327.pdf
